tools.name: is_on_subscription
tools.description: Use this to answer: "Is <game> on Game Pass?", "When does <game> leave Game Pass?", "Can I play <game> with a subscription?". Lists which subscriptions (currently PC Game Pass and Game Pass Ultimate) include the game in a region, their monthly price and the leave date when announced.

tools.name: search_games
tools.description: Find a PC game by title and get its id. Call this FIRST when the user names a game but you do not have its Steam AppID or igdb id, then pass the id to get_cheapest_way_to_play, get_offers or is_on_subscription. Returns up to 20 matches (id, title, slug).
